_comment: Field manifest for the Content Forge pack editor. Mirrors RomesteadContentForge/ContentPack.cs + PACKS.md. The editor builds its forms from this - add a field here when the DTO gains one, and editor + previews update. Field types: string,int,float,bool,enum,object,array,dict(keyed object),damageMap(type->float),file(png path),pointList([x,y] per line). Sections may set dict:true (the whole section is one key->value map), singleton:true (one object), aliases:[...] (alternate JSON keys for the same section, e.g. placeables/structures for furniture). file fields may set filter:'yarn' - the editor adds an 'Edit dialogue...' button opening the yarn dialogue editor. dict fields with valueType:'string' + keySource:'languages' (and the 'localized' sugar type) render as the per-language table widget.
_sourcesNote: Editable comboboxes for id fields. file = a reference/*.txt catalog (one id per line, '#'/blank skipped); list = inline; pack = ids defined in the current pack's section (intra-pack refs). Editable so your own NEW ids are still type-able.
